title: Palestine Exchange
summary: The official Palestine stock exchange platform, giving users comprehensive stock tracking, legal insights and in-depth Palestinian market information, redesigned for usability and visual clarity.

blocks.title: Goals
bullets: Align with the business on all needs.
Identify usability issues and possible information architecture enhancements.
Design a more usable, useful and visually appealing platform.

blocks.title: 01 — Competitive Analysis
blocks.body: A thorough competitive analysis identified industry-leading standards in information architecture, navigation and visual data representation.

blocks.title: 02 — Medium Fidelity Wireframes
blocks.body: Medium fidelity wireframes established the right information architecture, intuitive navigation and effective visual data representation before any visual design.

blocks.title: 03 — Designing a Better Experience
blocks.body: The wireframes were transformed into high fidelity designs that blend aesthetics with stronger functionality, elevating the trading experience.
